scope: Narrowed by the INFRA-14 architect at the round cap: the two round-7 findings and correctness.
roundSevenFindings: Both fixed in 8ec4e364. (1) The background client starts its keeper from ensureStreamOnce after its reconcile succeeds. startKeeper checks stopped() and writes keeperDone under c.mu, and awaitKeeper reads it under c.mu. Reconnect hooks run without c.mu (recovery.go:200-226), so there is no deadlock, and every Close/Drain interleaving ends with no leak and no endless wait. The deep agent's overlay mutation restoring the pre-fix start fails the gate test 7 of 10 times and the stop-before-connect test 20 of 20. (2) startDispatchStream connects with serverClient(dispatchStreamOptions(...)...) exactly as main.go:206 does. The round-7 mutation (background branch with plain streamCfg and no keeper) now fails three tests. Threads PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6xOPaw and PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6xOPa5 are accepted and resolved.

keyFindings.description: Fast-follow: on a second start, startDispatchStream returns once the stream looks reconciled, which the first start already made true, not once this client's ensureStreamOnce ran. So the 'second start writes nothing' check can miss a background-only extra write if the hook is slow (quality agent: an overlay mutation with a 150 ms hook delay passed 9 of 10). Not blocking: the reconcile both paths run is the one ensureStreamWithConfig, whose no-op on a matching stream the internal/bus tests check deterministically, and the hook adds no write of its own. Fix: wait for a signal that this client's first hook run finished.
